text: הֶחֱרַט בַּסֵּֽפֶר. לְבִלְתִּי מְצוֹא כֹּֽפֶר. קִיּוּם זִכְרוֹן זֶה סֵֽפֶר. לְפָנָיו יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר צָפוּן מֹרְדֵי אוֹר. תָּמִים דּוֹר כָּאוֹר. צִיָּה כְּחָר לָאוֹר. קְנוּיָו יִזְכֹּר: צְפוּפִים פְּנֵי נָאוֹר. מִשְׁפָּטָם תֵּת לָאוֹר. צַחַן רוֹעַ שְׂאוֹר. בְּרִיב בַּל יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר פְּעֻלַּת אֶזְרָח. הֵעַרְתָּהּ מִמִּזְרָח. פָּעֳלוֹ יִזְרָח. בְּקֶֽרֶב שָׁנִים יִזְכֹּר: פַּח אִם הָטְרַח. פִּרְחָיו לְמָרַח. פִּלּוּלוֹ יִצְרַח. בַּעֲדָם יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר עֲקֵדַת מוֹרִיָּה. כְּהִיַּת רְאִיָּה. עֲדֵי עֵרוֹם וְעֶרְיָה. סְבוּכוֹ יִזְכּוֹר: עֵֽצֶב טְרִיָּה. אִם כּוֹאֲבָה פּוֹרִיָּה. עֲתָרוֹ לִרְאִיָּה. וְלִזְכוּת יִזְכֹּר: זֵֽכֶר סֻלָּם חָלָם. וְעָלָיו מְחוֹלְלָם. שָׂרֵי אַרְבַּע וְעֻלָּם. בּוֹ כְּמֵאָז יִזְכֹּר: שְׂרִיגָיו בְּמַעֲלָם. וַיֹּאמַר לְגָעֳלָם. שִׂיחוֹ

He remembers the hidden one (Noah) in the age of open rebels, the perfect and the pure; when He is angry and wishes to curse the earth, He remembers those acquired by Him (Israel). As to those who stand crowded together before the countenance of the Awe-inspiring, may He bring to light their judgment; may He not in strife recall the ugly evil leaven. He remembers the work of that strong one whom He told to rise up from the east (Abraham). May He soon recall his shining act. When destruction threatens to annihilate his offspring, may his supplication become audible that He may remember them kindly. He remembers the sacrifice on Moriah (Isaac) whose eyes become dim; for the sake of people naked and bare, may He recall the ram caught in the thicket. When the fruitful people is afflicted with a festering wound, may his prayer be manifest that God may remember his merit. He remembers him who saw the ladder in the dream (Jacob); above it the Creator appeared to him, showed him the princes of the four empires and their yoke. He will remember him, as in former days. Who is it that hates gain that he might say: “Testify against me”, and the Lord Himself replied as a witness for remembrance. With a sucking lamb he (Samuel) atoned for us and, equal to the noble pair of brothers (Moses and Aaron), he rises for remembrance. At the time of drought I wait for Him who releases and brings rain (Elijah), who restored breath to the child already lost to remembrance. He lives on as a witness at circumcisions because he spoke of his zeal when the people had abandoned both covenant and remembrance.
